description: Created a centralized parseAiResponse utility to safely strip markdown, repair unescaped newlines/control characters, and catch truncated AI responses cleanly without crashing the server.

feature: API Route Refactoring for Safe Parsing
description: Replaced ad-hoc JSON parsing and backtracking logic with the new centralized parseAiResponse utility. Servers now return a clean 502 error with a user-friendly message when generation is truncated, and log the raw failed response for debugging.
Added buildChunkedGeneratePrompt to instruct the AI to generate only a specific subset of blueprint slots at a time, enforcing exact marks compliance and managing ICSI header placement across chunks.

Architected a sequential generation loop that breaks large paper blueprints into chunks (e.g., 5 questions per chunk), queries the LLMs sequentially, and merges the resulting text and question arrays. This completely bypasses the strict maxOutputTokens limits that were truncating large papers.
